issues.description: The NonNull equality boundary duplicates raw-pointer equality semantics instead of reusing the existing *mut T PartialEq specification.
issues.rationale: The file already imports vstd::std_specs::cmp, which supplies the raw-pointer PartialEq contract. Re-declaring the same address-and-metadata relation as a second trusted NonNull assume_specification creates an overlapping trust source that can drift. Review comment 4535917662 asks to reuse *mut T::eq; the final PR head replaces the hand-written relation with call_ensures on the raw-pointer implementation.
issues.source_evidence:
